test_styler_default_values: test that DataFrame.to_excel produces cells with no default font, border, or alignment styles
test_styler_to_excel_unstyled: test that Styler.to_excel produces identical cell values and styles as DataFrame.to_excel when unstyled
test_styler_custom_style: test applying CSS background-color style via Styler.map and verifying it renders in Excel
test_styler_to_excel_basic: test CSS styles including font, border, alignment, and number-format render correctly in Excel via Styler
test_styler_to_excel_border_style: test various CSS border styles like dashed, hair, dotted, double render correctly in Excel
test_styler_to_excel_basic_indexes: test CSS styles applied via Styler.map_index on row and column indexes render correctly in Excel
test_styler_custom_converter: test providing a custom style converter to ExcelFormatter for CSS-to-Excel style mapping
test_styler_to_s3: test writing a styled Styler to an S3 URI and reading it back with read_excel
test_format_hierarchical_rows_periodinde: test ExcelFormatter._format_hierarchical_rows converts PeriodIndex values to Timestamp in hierarchical rows
